verdict.rationale: Evidence shows Mixpanel has AI 'Agents' that monitor products continuously and surface anomalies (e.g., 'Signups dipped 19% last week') and can 'tell your team exactly what to do next,' suggesting some proactive alerting capability, but there is no explicit documentation of a dashboard subscription mechanism or configurable alert thresholds for PMs. missing for 10: explicit dashboard subscription feature, alert configuration/thresholds, delivery channels (email/Slack) for alerts.
